effect: The urinary organs are now connected to the body's circulation, completing the chapter.
reaction: The final picture clearly brings the blood supply and urine route together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtered fluid through recovery was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys take useful substances and water back into the blood rather than simply filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but less interesting; it mostly assembled a route already shown in the pictures.

surprise.text: The filter lets glucose and other useful small substances through along with wastes, so recovery is necessary.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The organ fittings were straightforward and had a clear purpose, even though they offered little to figure out.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: following the fluid made the kidney's two jobs understandable, and I would be curious to see another body system connected.
